scope: Best Picture nominees at the 1970-2026 Oscar ceremonies; 356 films; 57 complete ceremonies
rotten_tomatoes_source: Individual movie pages linked in oscar-nominees.csv; Tomatometer only
collection_notes: IMDb joined by title ID, not movie title.
Rotten Tomatoes identities matched by search title/release year, with manual resolution of ambiguous namesakes.
RT dateCreated may describe wide releases or rereleases; it does not determine ceremony membership.
All scores obtained 2026-09-15; historical rating values at Oscar time are not available in this snapshot.
Exploratory Kaggle and OscarPrediction ratings were not used in the final data.
Expanded scope requested by Ryan: 1970-2026 ceremonies, with 2026 nominees/winner checked against the official Academy ceremony page. Existing same-day observations retained.
